{{Quote|You did your part well, I must say. Unfortunately, Sertild betrayed the Society and told the Kerritamba of our plans. We were not able to deal with their leader. Such is life...|Dahlia Damask|<ref name="ROTW" />}}
'''Sertild''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] for the [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] [[Outcasts (Kashyyyk)|Outcasts]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROTW" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sertild was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the [[2005]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="ROTW" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
